verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's own marketing claims AI-powered chat and search that can drive actions like pipeline triage and Jira updates, and Rovo brings model access to the terminal and IDE. An official Atlassian MCP server also exists, which lets agents operate the product through natural-language requests. These are thin one-line claims, and none shows that users can actually run repo, PR, or pipeline operations by natural-language command. Missing for 10: documented scope of natural-language commands (which operations chat can execute), detailed first-party docs on the chat/Rovo command surface, MCP server tool coverage for Bitbucket specifically, hands-on or independent corroboration.
